metadata.comparison_protocol: Original fine P1 evaluated directly at reference-mesh quadrature points via a cached sparse transfer; analytic total incident wave. Reference-node fields are visualization output only.
metadata.error_units: error_fem_l2 is a ratio; all scattered_e_* and total_e_* are percent
metadata.timing_protocol: Offline once per grid for Type1, per k/grid for Type2; matrix projection and factorization once per k/grid/type. Reused costs repeat in per-case rows; unique totals are separate.
